definitions.explanation: purchasing food from a restaurant to eat elsewhere

examples.japanese: {持|も}ち{帰|かえ}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧お{願|ねが}いします。
⟦{店内|てんない}→店内：03124_tennai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食|た}べます→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧、{持|も}ち{帰|かえ}りです⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Will you eat here or take it to go?

examples.japanese: ⟦{残|のこ}った→残る：01187_nokoru⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{持|も}ち{帰|かえ}りにした。
examples.english: I took the leftover food to go.

examples.japanese: {持|も}ち{帰|かえ}り⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{税率|ぜいりつ}→税率：28616_zeiritsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
examples.english: The tax rate is different for takeout.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{持|も}ち{帰|かえ}り⟦{専門|せんもん}→専門：01251_senmon⟧だ。

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {持|も}ち{帰|かえ}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧お{願|ねが}いします (Takeout, please)
- お{持|も}ち{帰|かえ}りです⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ (Is it to go?)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦テイクアウト→テイクアウト：06180_teikuauto⟧ (takeout - loanword)
- ⟦{店内|てんない}→店内：03124_tennai⟧ (eating in)
- イートイン (eat-in)
- ⟦{出前|でまえ}→出前：08155_demae⟧ (delivery)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, the consumption tax rate differs between eating in (⟦{店内|てんない}→店内：03124_tennai⟧) and takeout ({持|も}ち{帰|かえ}り), with takeout having a lower rate (8% vs 10%). Staff typically ask which you prefer.

KANJI READING:
Also pronounced もちかえり. ⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{帰|かえ}る→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧ means 'to take home.'
